briefings.title: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch on Building the Internet for Agents
briefings.tldr: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch explains how AI coding agents have driven Vercel's deployment volume up 1.5 billion in just 10 months (reaching 60% agentic deployments), fundamentally shifting the internet from human-centric pages to agent-native protocols, and turning Vercel into a $9.3B infrastructure powerhouse with $600M in annualized revenue.

briefings.title: Why The Harness Matters More Than The Model | YC Paper Club
briefings.tldr: The harness—the layer between an LLM and the world providing persistent state, tools, and compute—matters more than the model weights alone, enabling the same model to jump from 30% to 95+% on benchmarks like ARC-AGI simply through improved scaffolding.

briefings.title: A year ago, ChatGPT felt untouchable. Not anymore.
briefings.tldr: The AI landscape is experiencing unprecedented acceleration, with a fierce rivalry between OpenAI and Anthropic driving rapid advancements in AI agents and development tools that are making software creation effectively "free" and reshaping the entire industry from enterprise to individual users.

briefings.title: OpenAI vs. Anthropic, the AI shift that's rattling software stocks and AI Super bowl commercials
briefings.tldr: The AI landscape is experiencing unprecedented acceleration, disrupting traditional software markets and fueling an intense "war" among major AI labs for enterprise, developer, and consumer dominance through increasingly capable, agentic models that empower even non-technical users to build and deploy sophisticated applications.
